_schema: Optional sidecar for the Indicator Monitor (same folder as index.html). The page is static and has no API keys. Fields here OVERRIDE live values when present, or FILL gaps when a live CORS-friendly source is unavailable (US Treasury yields and the HY credit spread cannot be fetched in-browser without a key). Omitted fields are left to live APIs or shown as n/a with a source link. All dates are calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) or ISO-8601 timestamps; the page displays times in Europe/London. Numbers: yields and spreads in percent (4.98 means 4.98%), ETF flows in millions of USD (−95 means −$95.0M), gold and DXY in the usual spot units, strategyAvgCost in USD per BTC.

_fields.macro.us2y / us10y / hyCredit / dxy / go: { value: number, asOf: 'YYYY-MM-DD' or ISO, source?: string, url?: string }. 2s10s is computed from 10y−2y when both are present; you may also set macro.us2s10s the same way.
_fields.etfFlows: { source, url, latestDate, days: [{ date, total, IBIT?, FBTC?, MSBT?, ...other tickers }] }. Totals and per-fund flows are USD millions.
_fields.strategyAvgCost: USD average cost to mark as a labelled line on the BTC chart (Strategy / MicroStrategy).
_fields.calendar: Extra events merged with the hard-coded list: [{ id, title, time (ISO-8601), note? }].
